Such public demonstrations illustrate the persistent opposition any administration encounters while trying to enact essential reforms.

A report suggests nearly 25 ultra-luxury housing projects will be completed in this period. Major developers have partnered with renowned brands to cater to the super-rich market. The demand for these residences is driven by rapidly increasing wealth among high-net-worth individuals. This trend reflects changing consumer expectations for quality and lifestyle within the luxury segment.

title: US Stocks: 3M lifts annual profit forecast on cost controls, price hikes
